newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motor to sell 3.5-litre GDI-engine Pajero.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motor to sell 3.5-litre GDI-engine Pajero.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Wednesday it will introduce a partially remodelled Pajero sport-utility vehicle (SUV) in Japan featuring a new high-efficiency, low-emission engine.
The new version of the Pajero, Mitsubishi's mainstay SUV model, will go on sale on May 9 with a monthly sales target of 4,400 units.

The new Pajero model will feature a V-6 3.5-litre version of Mitsubishi's gasoline direct injection (GDI) engine, which consumes 30 percent less fuel and emits 30 percent less carbon dioxide than comparable conventional engines, although it is 10 percent more powerful, the company said.
Mitsubishi introduced the GDI engine for the first time last August in its new Galant and Legnum models.

The company sold 34,418 Galants and 49,994 Legnums during the first eight months after the launch. About 90 percent of the Galants and more than 40 percent of the Legnums had GDI engines, a Mitsubishi spokesman said.
Mitsubishi will also offer conventional V-6 3-litre and 2.4-litre gasoline engines and a 2.8-litre diesel engine in its new Pajero models.
